keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria's Swaziland row starts in 1885). The Eswatini page puts the Ngwane capital at Shiselweni under Ngwane III and at Zombodze 'in the heartland of present-day Eswatini' under Sobhuza I; the History page has Ngwane III 'crossed the Pongola' and set up homes in the 'Magudu hills, Mzinsangu, and Zombodze', so the early state straddled the present border. No frontier is given; present-day eSwatini is the stand-in. Confidence 1.

ledger.note: After 1744: Ngwane III succeeds Dlamini III and founds the Ngwane/Swazi kingdom. History page: Dlamini III ruled 'approximately between 1720 until 1744'; 'Ngwane III succeeded his father, crossed the Pongola'; Eswatini page: 'the first King of modern Swaziland'. The page gives no year for Ngwane III's accession, so 1744 (Dlamini III's end) is a bridge; page silent on the founding year.

1815 (the accession; the move itself is undated): Sobhuza I (Somhlolo) 'became king in 1815' and moved 'his capital from Zombodze in Shiselweni to the centre of Swaziland at another kraal called Zombodze' (History of Eswatini, which ties the move to the conflict with the Ndwandwe and gives it no year). [Reviewer af-07-x, 2026-10-19: the sentence earlier quoted as a page timeline entry ('1815: Ndvungunye died ... moved the capital to Zombodze in central Swaziland') is not on the page; confidence lowered to 2.]

notes: Cliopatria's Swaziland row starts only in 1885; af-07-b writes it. This dossier covers the Swazi kingdom before it: Mfecane-era Swazi state of Ngwane III, Sobhuza I, Mswati II and Mbandzeni. Two pages: History_of_Eswatini (dated reigns and treaties) and the Eswatini article (opened as Kingdom_of_Eswatini; the capital sentences and the 'twice its current size' line). Not recorded because the land is not named: the 1846 and 1855 land sales to the Dutch republics (170 cattle each; 'the wording was vague'), the Swazi-Pedi, Swazi-Ndwandwe conflicts (undated: 'conflict with the Ndwandwe under Zwide pushed the Swazi north'), and Mswati II's 1850s campaigns. The ring is area-matched, not surveyed. Mpumalanga after 1881 is not drawn as Swazi. Rulers (History page): Dlamini III c. 1720-1744; Ngwane III (accession year not given); Ndvungunye 1780-1815; Sobhuza I 1815-1839; Mswati II 1839-1865; regency (Tsandzile Ndwandwe) to 1875; Mbandzeni from 1875 (the 1872 note: Ludvonga died, Mbandzeni chosen). Counterparts: south-african-republic and portuguese-mozambique (this batch), swaziland (af-07-b), ndwandwe-kingdom and pedi-empire (this batch), zululand (af-07-b), lydenburg-republic (no dossier). Gazetteer names needed: Barberton, Zombodze, Shiselweni (site), Nomahasha.
